en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Al Husayn Bin Usman, and Muhammad Bin Abu Hamza, from Is’haq Bin Ammar, and someone else, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said,

‘I asked him<sup>asws</sup> about the man who emancipated his owned slave, and married him to his own daughter, and stipulated a condition upon him that if he were to deceive her, he would be returned in the slavery. He<sup>asws</sup> said; ‘It is for him to stipulate it’.
